expressionProfile.purpose: Preserved first-profile shapes and timing for matching-camera/event comparison.

limits.format: Runtime THREE.Group assets with real geometry; static snapshots can be exported centrally.
limits.art: Original Cloudstitch warm handmade fantasy; cream cloth, honey wood, teal enamel, brass and coral patches. Latest direction: 10x bolder dramatic presence through distinct large forms, material layers and anticipation/release/afterglow rhythm, not a numeric scale or damage multiplier.
limits.motion: Procedural mesh/group deformation and timed layers; no fluid, skeletal cloth or particle-engine simulation.
limits.gameplay: The separate simulation owns collision, drift, damage, icing and heat. Visual mesh count never changes gameplay rules.
limits.scope: Local weather test course; no campaign, save migration, production colliders, LODs or approved performance budget.

expressionProfile.direction: Latest 2026-10-18 user instruction: 10x bolder, more dramatic and abundant expression; no gameplay multiplier.

layers.cloud: Sweeping entry veils around the reused cloud bank; the flight corridor remains readable.
layers.updraft: Three distinct stages: broad low inlet curls, rising helical body, petal-shaped top outflow and dispersing seeds.
layers.crosswind: The sock first bends against the coming gust; long tapered cloth flows race through, then the sock rebounds and settles.
layers.lightning: Separated charge strands converge toward the fixed warning target, split into striking forks, and leave pale rising afterglow.
layers.icing: Large jagged crystal fans plus fine sugar frost on an engine housing; preheating releases separate steam curls and ballistic sparks.
layers.thermal: Pressure pulses and nozzle breaths precede a thick tapered brush stream; side scrolls curl upward and grey residual vapor outlives the burst.
